WatchScoreInsufficientReason.description:
Why `score_unit` did not assess the unit. A unit that cannot be scored is never Quiet.

The first five members match `WatchInsufficientReason` / the pre-registered v0 model so a
wrapper can pass reasons through. The rest are port-level: no weights, missing cube layers,
or a unit the view does not contain. This enum is *not* a change to `slope-watch-state`.
WatchScoreInsufficientReason.title: WatchScoreInsufficientReason

WatchTier.description: Ordinal state of a slope unit. Never a probability, never a date.
WatchTier.title: WatchTier

description:
One slope unit scored at one `as_of` by a `WatchAnomalyModel`.

`score` is the implementing model's anomaly statistic (v0: robust z; v1: a reconstruction
residual, once weights exist). It is not a probability of collapse and not a predicted
date of collapse. `max_input_time` is the latest sample the model actually used and must
satisfy `max_input_time <= as_of`, matching `anomaly.py`'s `t <= T` inclusive window.

max_input_time.description: Latest sample time actually consumed. Inclusive trailing windows allow equality with as_of (t <= as_of). Null when no causal sample was present.
max_input_time.title: Max Input Time

score.description: Anomaly statistic from the implementing model. Null when the unit was not assessed. NOT a probability of collapse and NOT a predicted date of collapse.
score.title: Score

tier.description: Ordinal watch tier, or null when the model did not assess the unit. Unmeasurable/unfitted units use insufficient_data (or null), never quiet.

title: UnitWatchScore
